key_insight: DeHNSSo-v2 extends nonlinear shear-flow stability analysis to compressible flows and curved geometries while achieving approximately 10× speed-up on DeHNSSo-v1 nonlinear test cases.
engineering_relevance: The solver supports boundary-layer transition and flow-control studies involving nonlinear disturbances, complex surfaces, and metamaterials across compressibility regimes.
method: Compressible formulation on body-fitted 2D grids with fourth-order spatial accuracy.
Automatic grid generation, linear-cost sparse assembly, and reusable per-mode factorizations.
Newton pseudo-arclength continuation for high-amplitude nonlinear solutions.
evidence_signal: Validation includes linear boundary-layer instability benchmarks at Mach 0.5–4.5, nonlinear breakdown at Mach 1.6, swept-wing crossflow comparisons with DNS, and resonator interactions compared with experimentally validated linearized simulations.
watch_item: The approximately 10× speed-up is demonstrated on earlier-version nonlinear test cases and should not be assumed for every geometry or flow regime.
paper_title: DeHNSSo-v2: A compressible, curvilinear, and efficient extension of the Delft Harmonic Navier-Stokes Solver
